pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth, sub-rounded edge gradients. Spatial area is greatest on the cervical region with larger, elongated shapes, transitioning to smaller, more densely clustered patches on the posterior flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous off-white topological network separating the patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate (Y-shaped) intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, maintaining structural continuity without significant bottlenecks.
